up: Retrieve the first 1000 IC50 activity rows for a specific human single-protein target (CHEMBL216: Muscarinic acetylcholine receptor M1) with associated canonical SMILES and pChEMBL values, ensuring results are sorted by molecule ChEMBL ID and assay ChEMBL ID. The query must: (1) restrict to human single-protein target CHEMBL216, (2) include assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax_id, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value, (3) retain exact standard relation '=' rows with non-null pChEMBL values, (4) order by molecule_chembl_id (ascending) then assay_chembl_id (ascending), (5) not filter on additional fields (e.g., assay confidence score, assay organims, activity end points, or source metadata).
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT a.standard_type, a.pchembl_value, cs.canonical_smiles, a.assay_id, td.target_type, td.tax_id, a.molecule_chembl_id
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molecule_chembl_id = md.chembl_id
JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molecule_chembl_id = cs.molecule_chembl_id
WHERE a.standard_type = 'IC50' AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL AND td.pref_name = 'Muscarinic acetylcholine receptor M1' AND td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL216'
ORDER BY a.molecule_chembl_id ASC, a.assay_id ASC
LIMIT 1000;

WITH mol AS (

assay_td AS (
  SELECT a.assay_id, a.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id, a.tid
  FROM assays a
),
td AS (
  SELECT tid, target_type, tax_id
  FROM target_dictionary
  WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL216'
  AND pref_name = 'Muscarinic acetylcholine receptor M1'

SELECT
  ass.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id,
  td.target_type,
  td.tax_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
  a.standard_type,
  a.pchembl_value
FROM activities a
JOIN assay_td ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN td ON a.tid = td.tid
JOIN mol md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN struct cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno

ORDER BY md.chembl_id ASC, ass.chembl_id ASC
